title: 📋 PINK Boutique - Development Update [ November 26 - December 1, 2025 ]
body:
🔧 Admin Panel Updates
🏠 Quick Access Section Control (NEW!)
A powerful new feature has been added to manage the Quick Access section on the mobile app's home page directly from the admin panel.

What You Can Do:

Toggle Quick Access visibility - Choose which categories appear in the Quick Access section on the home page
Custom ordering - Set the display order so your most important categories appear first
Custom images - Upload a separate image for Quick Access cards, or use the main category image as default
Real-time updates - Changes made in the admin panel are instantly reflected on users' home screens
Visual Indicator:

Categories enabled for Quick Access now display a small "Quick" badge in the top-left corner of their card in the category management panel, making it easy to see at a glance which categories are featured
🔍 Enhanced Search & Filtering
The inventory table search has been significantly upgraded:

Multi-Field Search:

Search now scans across multiple fields simultaneously:
Product name
Price
Category & Subcategory
Store location
Tags
New Location Filters:

Multi-location filter - Select multiple store locations to filter by
"No Locations Assigned" filter - Quickly find items that haven't been assigned to any store location
"Missing Specific Locations" filter - Find items missing from particular stores
Active Filter Chips:

All active filters are now displayed as visual chips at the top of the table
Each filter chip has its own remove button for quick deselection
Location filters show each selected location separately for precise control
📦 Bulk Category Assignment Improvements
Independent Subcategory Updates:

You can now update only the subcategory for multiple items without changing the main category
Previously, bulk editing required selecting a main category first
Dark Theme Fixes:

The bulk category assignment dialog now fully supports dark mode
All dropdowns, checkboxes, and text elements properly respect your theme preference
📂 Category Management Enhancements
Two-Column Layout:

Quick Access settings are now organized in a cleaner two-column layout within the edit dialog
Image Handling Improvements:

Image previews now fit properly within their containers (no more awkward cropping)
Remove button for Quick Access images works correctly for both new and existing images
Image uploads now reliably persist when saving
Category Image Upload:

Upload custom images for categories directly through the admin panel
Supports both standard image files and base64 encoded images
🎨 Visual & Theme Updates
Dark/Light Theme Toggle:

Full dark mode support throughout the admin panel
Theme preference is remembered across sessions
Shimmer Loading Effects:

Elegant loading animations have been added to the dashboard
Skeleton loaders appear while data is being fetched, providing a smoother visual experience
Responsive Dialogs:

All dialog windows (Edit Item, Create Item, Category Assignment, etc.) are now responsive
Dialogs automatically adjust their size based on your screen dimensions
Works seamlessly on different monitor sizes
⚡ Performance Improvements
Real-Time Streaming:

Category changes made in the admin panel now broadcast instantly to all connected mobile apps
No need for users to refresh—updates appear automatically
